name: Ilhan Kyuchyuk - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2015/848 on insolvency proceedings to replace its Annexes A and B
part_text:
The European Union has a list of national insolvency proceedings that count as official across borders. This report updates that list. It adds new procedures from Bulgaria and the Czech Republic, fixes the names of some procedures in Spain, Malta and France, and adds a Czech insolvency practitioner to the separate list of practitioners. It also notes that Ireland has chosen to take part in these rules. The Parliament adopts this position for talks with the Council.

- The cross-border insolvency lists gain new Bulgarian and Czech procedures and one Czech practitioner.
- People and businesses in insolvency in those countries get clearer cross-border recognition.
- Parliament and the Council now negotiate the final text.
